mapper.select: SELECT attendance_source_id FROM attendance_source WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND source_type = 'PAPER_OVERTIME' AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT employee.employee_id AS employeeId, employee_version.employee_number AS employeeNumber, employee_version.display_name AS displayName, employment.organization_id AS organizationId, organization_version.name AS departmentName, employee_version.status AS employmentStatus FROM employee employee JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= #{asOf} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{asOf} ) JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(employment.effective_from) <= #{asOf} AND ( employment.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(employment.effective_to) > #{asOf} ) JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND DATE(organization_version.effective_from) <= #{asOf} AND ( organization_version.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(organization_version.effective_to) > #{asOf} ) WHERE employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND ( #{name} IS NULL OR #{name} = '' OR employee_version.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR employee_version.employee_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN employee_version.display_name = #{name} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN organization_version.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{department}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, employee_version.employee_number LIMIT 20

SELECT employee.employee_id AS employeeId, employee_version.employee_number AS employeeNumber, employee_version.display_name AS displayName, employment.organization_id AS organizationId, organization_version.name AS departmentName, employee_version.status AS employmentStatus FROM employee employee JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= #{asOf} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{asOf} ) JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_id = employment.organization_id WHERE employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND employee.employee_id = #{employeeId} LIMIT 1

SELECT document.oa_attendance_document_id AS documentId, document.source_business_key AS sourceBusinessKey, normalized.interval_start AS intervalStart, normalized.interval_end AS intervalEnd FROM oa_attendance_document document JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = document.normalized_attendance_record_id JOIN employee_match_decision match_decision ON match_decision.normalized_attendance_record_id = normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id WHERE match_decision.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND match_decision.match_status = 'MATCHED' AND document.document_type = 'OVERTIME' AND document.source_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED') AND normalized.interval_start IS NOT NULL AND normalized.interval_end IS NOT NULL

SELECT line.paper_overtime_line_id AS lineId, line.paper_overtime_batch_id AS batchId, line.employee_id AS employeeId, employee_version.employee_number AS employeeNumber, employee_version.display_name AS employeeName, organization_version.name AS departmentName, line.overtime_date AS overtimeDate, line.start_at AS startAt, line.end_at AS endAt, line.overtime_type AS overtimeType, line.reason AS reason, line.oa_attendance_document_id AS documentId FROM paper_overtime_line line JOIN paper_overtime_batch batch ON batch.paper_overtime_batch_id = line.paper_overtime_batch_id LEFT JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_id = line.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= COALESCE(line.overtime_date, CURRENT_DATE) AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > COALESCE(line.overtime_date, CURRENT_DATE) ) LEFT JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = line.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND DATE(organization_version.effective_from) <= COALESCE(line.overtime_date, CURRENT_DATE) AND ( organization_version.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(organization_version.effective_to) > COALESCE(line.overtime_date, CURRENT_DATE) ) WHERE batch.company_id = #{companyId} AND batch.status = 'SAVED' AND ( #{fromDate} IS NULL OR line.overtime_date IS NULL OR line.overtime_date >= #{fromDate} ) AND ( #{toDate} IS NULL OR line.overtime_date IS NULL OR line.overtime_date <= #{toDate} ) ORDER BY line.overtime_date, employee_version.employee_number, line.paper_overtime_line_id
